question: Should Trubbo sell extra question categories, and how (single category, bundle, part of subscription), at what price, and which categories do players want enough to pay for?

codebook.too_little_free: complains that too few categories/decks are free, or that the good ones are locked
codebook.double_pay: already paid (app price or subscription) and is still asked to pay per category/pack
codebook.pack_price_high: says a pack, deck or bundle price is too expensive
codebook.happy_buyer: bought packs/decks/categories or premium for content and says it was worth it, or is glad to pay
codebook.lost_purchases: bought packs disappeared, restore fails, asked to pay again after new phone/update
codebook.not_delivered_or_misled: charged but pack not received, accidental purchase, or bundle did not contain what was expected
codebook.sub_resented: resents a subscription being required to unlock categories/content; wants to pay once
codebook.wants_unlock_all: asks for one purchase / one price that unlocks everything
codebook.requests_category: asks for a specific new category, theme or topic (put it in `theme`, e.g. 'anime', '80s music')
codebook.praises_variety: praises the number or variety of categories/topics
codebook.content_exhausted: questions repeat, content ran out, no new categories added
codebook.category_quality: wrong, poor, mis-filed or too US-centric questions within a category
codebook.age_filter: wants kid-safe or adult content separated/hidden, or praises kids/adult packs
codebook.ads: complains about ads or pays/would pay to remove them
codebook.currency_grind: complains about coins/gems/lives/energy economy or pay-to-win
codebook.dev_insight: a developer or experienced player states what works or fails when selling content (packs vs unlock-all vs subscription, pricing, conversion) - always add a quote
codebook.other: on the topic of paying for content or categories but none of the above (describe in `quote`)
